title: Autocode Continuous Planner structured draft contract
description: Versioned machine-readable contract for structured Planner drafts produced by the backend Planner dispatch pipeline. Every structured result must validate against this schema through tools/autocode_planner_contract.py before it may be committed as an accepted plan-draft revision; schema-invalid drafts are rejected so the previous usable draft is preserved.

contract_version.description: Version of this structured-draft contract; bumped on any incompatible change.

kind.description: Discriminator separating structured Planner results from chat replies and other payloads.

goal.description: The structured goal the Planner derived from the requirements conversation.

requirements.description: Structured requirements rows; objects are preserved verbatim for richer later records.

milestones.description: Milestone rows of the structured plan.

parallelism.description: Parallelism/grouping rows of the structured plan.

unresolved_questions.description: Outstanding questions the Architect must see resolved before acceptance.

requirements_revision.description: Exact requirements-state revision this structured result answers.

logical_turn_id.description: Logical human turn that prompted this structured result.

source_revision.description: Binding of this result to the exact requirements revision and logical turn; results bound to older revisions/turns must never be committed over newer input.

role.description: Producing role, e.g. the independent Planner role (never the Gatherer).

model.description: Exact model that produced the structured result.

reasoning_effort.description: Reasoning effort used for the producing run (no silent fallback).

engine.description: Engine/transport of the producing run, when known.

provider.description: Provider of the producing run, when known.

reasoning_summary.description: Retained reasoning provenance for the structured result.

attribution.description: Actual role/model/reasoning attribution persisted with every accepted draft.

state.description: Freshness granted only by a real structured Planner result bound to the current requirements revision; 'failed' retains error evidence.

error.description: Retained error evidence for failed structured results.

freshness.description: Source-revision freshness of the structured result, including failed states with retained error evidence; provenance keys such as source ids ride along.
